Identity & Access Management: Administer Microsoft Entra ID and Okta, including users, groups, SSO integrations, MFA, Conditional Access, and third-party application permissions.
eligibility_evidence: Work Environments: Hybrid: A combination of office and remote work, with regular office presence required for hardware management and in-person employee support.
